snippet.title: NEVER SAFE IN DELAWARE - GAMEPLAY TRAILER
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3847550/NEVER_SAFE_IN_DELAWARE/
...
Take control of three of America’s most dangerous fugitives in a breakneck, intense battle against the scum and criminals infesting the city. NEVER SAFE IN DELAWARE is a brand new action game that we've been working on for a little while. Does anyone read these descriptions? Anyway, you should really wishlist the game cuz it helps us out a lot. Also you'll get notified on the game's release status and all that cool stuff.
